basics.name: Mark Cheli
basics.label: Director, Product Operations & Strategy · Onshape (PTC)
basics.summary: I run Product Operations & Strategy for Onshape, the cloud-native CAD platform that is PTC's fastest-growing business. The team makes sure the people deciding what the product does next have what they need to decide well: the analysis, the strategy work, the information moving through the org. Then it keeps the plan honest. AI is a big part of the job and of how I work. At Onshape I run the tooling, guidelines and budget for Claude and the other AI tools across the whole company, not just R&D, and I spend a lot of my own time building with agents. I came up through PTC as a software engineer, intern to director across a lot of different roles and organizations, and I still write code for whatever needs it, product features included. That's the common thread: I build things. Software mostly, but also welding, 3D printing, and three old trucks. This site runs on a server in my basement, next to the apps I've built for myself.

work.name: Onshape (PTC)
work.summary: Product Operations & Strategy supports the people who decide what Onshape does next: the strategy and analysis behind the decisions, the planning cycle that turns them into work, the analytics that say how it's going, and the programs that cut across every team. I'm responsible for the team and for a good share of its output.
highlights: AI at Onshape: how the organization adopts it. The tooling, guidelines, governance and budget for Claude and other AI tools across the company, and what it changes about how software gets built.
Strategy and analysis for product decisions, the planning cycle, and the product analytics and data warehouse behind both.
The programs that cut across every team, localization and legal among them, and product management for the tools the org runs on.

Software engineering when something needs building, product features and the tooling around them alike. Thirteen years at PTC from intern to director, across engineering, product and operations roles.
2022: interim head of business operations for the Onshape business unit.
